text: The paragraph describes a scenario that likely violates legal labor standards. Extending working hours beyond the maximum permitted by local labor laws is illegal, regardless of whether management claims it is a one-time exception. Additionally, failing to increase pay for extra hours worked, particularly if those hours exceed standard or legal limits, likely violates wage and hour laws which typically require overtime pay for hours worked beyond a certain threshold. The combination of exceeding legal hour limits and not compensating employees appropriately constitutes non-compliance with standard labor regulations.
